description: An oil-style painting on a dark background. A wooden rack holds a row of six glass test tubes, each plugged with fluffy white cotton, and several tubes contain pinkish-orange and grey fuzzy growths over a pale medium. In front stand amber glass bottles with blank paper labels, a clear glass bottle, a glass beaker, a porcelain dish, a flask of yellow liquid, and dried leaves and a glass tube on a worn wooden bench. No legible text, no frame visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
